story:
[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan ran three laps around the chair because he was so excited. His new video game, **Quest of the Red Dragon**, had a secret treasure chest that nobody had found yet.

"I think it's behind the tall, wooden bridge," Ethan told his friend Maya, who had came over after school.

[gesture:slight_no] Maya shook her head. "I went there yesterday. Nothing was there.[emotion:QT/sad] "

Ethan felt his excitement shrink, like a balloon losing air.

[gesture:think] "Maybe we should check the dark cave below the bridge," Maya said, while Ethan watched the screen carefully.

"You moved left, then I'll watch right," Ethan said, leaning forward.

After that, a small glowing chest appeared in the corner they had both been searching.

[emotion:QT/happy] "We found it!" Ethan shouted.

Maya laughed. [emotion:QT/happy] "That happened because we each looked in a different spot![gesture:think] "

Ethan thought about how much harder the quest would have been alone. He gave Maya a huge grin, and she grinned right back. [emotion:QT/happy]

Ethan and Maya sitting together in front of the video game screen, Ethan pointing at the screen and talking about the wooden bridge.

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan and his quest for the treasure chest?
questions.correct_answer: Working together as a team helps you reach your goal
wrong_answers: Searching alone is the best way to find treasure
Video games are too hard to finish

questions.question: After Maya shook her head, where did she think they should check for the treasure chest?
questions.correct_answer: The dark cave below the bridge
wrong_answers: In the corner near the starting point

questions.question: What happened right after Ethan watched the left side of the screen while Maya watched the right?
questions.correct_answer: A small glowing chest appeared in the corner
wrong_answers: The Red Dragon chased their characters away
Maya went home before they could find anything

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan felt his excitement shrink, like a balloon losing air, when Maya shook her head?
questions.correct_answer: Because his best idea for finding the treasure was already wrong
wrong_answers: Because he thought the treasure chest was not real
Because Maya was better at the game than him

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Ethan had searched for the treasure chest without his helper Maya?
questions.correct_answer: The quest would have been much harder and he might not have found it
wrong_answers: He would have found the chest faster on his own
The Red Dragon would have shown him where the chest was

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan and Maya to each search a different spot?
questions.correct_answer: Working together helps you solve problems that feel too big alone.
wrong_answers: Playing video games for a long time will always lead you to the answer.
Searching the same spot twice is the best way to find hidden treasure.

questions.question: What did Ethan show us by listening to Maya's idea about the dark cave?
questions.correct_answer: Asking a friend for help is a smart and brave thing to do.
wrong_answers: Waiting patiently on your own is the best way to figure things out.
Trying every possible place by yourself will always get you the best result.

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story about how Ethan and Maya felt when they found the chest?
questions.correct_answer: Sharing a win with someone makes it feel even better.
wrong_answers: Winning a game is most exciting when you keep the news to yourself.
Finishing a challenge quickly is what makes it the most rewarding.

takeaways: Working together helps you solve problems that feel too big alone.
Asking a friend for help is a smart and brave thing to do.
Sharing a win with someone makes it feel even better.
